race.comment: ZHENG YOU (3) looks the one ready to fire. Fitter for two runs back and put the writing on the wall with a last start placing. Won only try this course and distance and the mile is ideal now. Looks to have found a golden opportunity to return to winning ways. CONEY ISLAND BABY (7) fought on well for third last start this course and distance and continues to race well. Leading player again. Like many of these BOTANICA (6) comes through a race at Esk won by Kareem. First try at the mile but huge weight drop and should give a sight off a far better draw. CARDIOLOGIST (2) is also having first try at the mile and can improve sharply.
